excerpt.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]的政界中逐渐壮大。他们自称[Root.GetName]。
excerpt.en: A new faction has recently been gaining traction in the internal political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]的政界中逐渐壮大。他们自称[Root.GetName]。
texts.en: A new faction has recently been gaining traction in the internal political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]稚嫩的政界中浮出水面。他们自称为[Root.GetName]。
texts.en: A new faction has emerged in the nascent political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于确保我们对星系其他区域的军事统治。
texts.en: Their members have been pushing hard for us to assert our military dominance over the rest of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于使用我们武器库中所有强大的强化体武器来统治星系的其余部分。
texts.en: Their members are committed to wielding every formidable, augmented weapon in our arsenal to assert dominance over the rest of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 他们的成员倡议关闭边境并且对星系事务保持不干涉原则。
texts.en: Their members are advocating for closed borders and non-interference with galactic affairs.

texts.zh: 他们的成员提倡封闭边界，创造一个不受机器和其他星系实体干扰的社会。
texts.en: Their members are advocating for closed borders, and a society free of interference from machines and other galactic entities.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于我们帝国境内所有居民的平等与公正。
texts.en: Their members work for equality and justice for all denizens of our empire.

texts.zh: 他们的成员寻求与星系邻居达成友好协议，以及为我们帝国的所有居民伸张正义。
texts.en: Their members seek friendly accord with our galactic neighbors and justice for all denizens of our empire.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于让国家专注于通过和平的手段来发展经济与维护社会稳定。
texts.en: Their members lobby for a national focus on financial growth and stability through peaceful means.

texts.zh: 他们的成员游说通过和平手段实现商业增长和稳定，避免军国主义扩张。
texts.en: Their members lobby for mercantile growth and stability through peaceful means, free of militaristic augmentation.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于确保[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的至高地位，有必要的可以缩减其他外星物种的权利。
texts.en: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, by curtailing the rights of aliens if necessary.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于维护[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的优先地位，用我们自己生产的强大机械加以增强。
texts.en: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, augmented by formidable machines of our own making.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于科学进步与成就。
texts.en: Their members have been pushing hard for the advancement of the sciences.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于科学的进步以及对自身强化件的理解。
texts.en: Their members have been pushing hard for advancement of the sciences, and better understanding of our augments.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动一个极端集权的政治体系的出现以及提高军事权威。
texts.en: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of political and military power.

texts.zh: 他们的成员一直致力于推动主权政治权力和军事力量的极端集中，尽可能效仿我们所知的机械智能。
texts.en: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of sovereign political power and military might, modelled on what we know of Machine Intelligences.

texts.zh: 他们的成员支持唯心与保守观念。
texts.en: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values.

texts.zh: 他们的成员支持唯心与保守观念，与我们过去自然、有机的理念相一致。
texts.en: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values, many of which align with theories about our natural, organic past.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动与其他外星物种的友好关系。
texts.en: Their members have been pushing hard for friendly relations with alien species.

texts.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动与其他外星物种的友好关系，摆脱过去机械意识留下的阴影。
texts.en: Their members have been pushing hard for friendly relations with alien species, unburdened by the specter of our Machine past.

texts.zh: 他们的成员在各种无政府议题上表达了五彩缤纷的抗议，要求建立一个更富表达和平等的社会。
texts.en: Their members have sparked colorful protests on various anarchic issues, demanding a more expressive and egalitarian society.

texts.zh: 其成员倡导心灵主义价值，颂扬艰苦与忍耐。体能试炼在其社会中占重要地位。
texts.en: Their members promote spiritualist values, praising hardship and the ability to suffer through it. Physical trials play a significant role in their society.

texts.zh: 要求得不到满足的派系会成为麻烦的源头，而支持帝国工作的派系可以为我们所用……
texts.en: A disgruntled faction will be a source of trouble, but one that approves of the government's actions could prove useful...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个派系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this faction appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.en: In the game, your species' adjective appears here.

summary.text:
# 派系已建立 / Faction Founded
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 派系事件 faction event
- 来源 Sources：`events/faction_events.txt:12-220` · `common/pop_faction_types/00_pyrolatry.txt:344`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

任何派系成立时，隐藏事件 factions.0（pop_faction_event）触发：破碎枷锁起源除外，它先强制评估所有人口群的派系归属；如果这是本国的第一个派系（country flag first_faction）→ 弹出教学式事件 **1 派系成立**；否则只发出“派系成立”的消息（传统主义 / 帝国主义 / 至上主义 / 孤立主义 / 极权 / 进步 / 繁荣 / 技术 / 异族 / 马尼斐斯蒂）。烈焰教派创立时也直接发 factions.1。/ Any new faction fires hidden factions.0; the first faction of an empire gets the explainer event 1, later ones only a message; the fire cult sends 1 directly.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**派系成立（1）**：说明派系的概念，文本随起源（拔线者起源有专门版本）与派系类型（含马尼斐斯蒂、烈焰教派）变化；唯一选项“好”，并强制重新评估所有人口群。/ Explains factions; text depends on origin and faction type; the only option forces a faction re-evaluation.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单事件。/ A single event.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

文本因派系类型和起源而异。/ Text varies with faction type and origin.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：0 与 1 的脚本，派系 on_create 调用。/ Scripts 0 and 1 and the on_create callers.
- 审阅改动 Changes：结构无改动。/ No structural change.
